title: Integrative multi-omics analysis identifies methylation-associated lncRNAs FAM83A-AS2 and AC012213.1 as candidate prognostic markers in lung adenocarcinoma

evidence_spans.quote: Results By integrating RNA-seq and Illumina 450K methylation data
Cox models (adjusted for age, sex, and tumor stage)

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This empirical lung-cancer analysis is biological, but age is used only as an adjustment covariate and no aging construct is analyzed.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: Promoter methylation associated with lncRNA expression
causal_design_reviewer.outcome: Overall survival; two-lncRNA prognostic score discrimination
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Spearman methylation–expression associations; Kaplan–Meier and adjusted Cox-model survival associations

evidence_spans.quote: By integrating RNA-seq and Illumina 450K methylation data from 473 LUAD and 32 normal lung samples in TCGA, we identified 2,668 differentially expressed lncRNAs
Spearman correlation analysis highlighted seven lncRNAs with inverse promoter methylation–expression patterns
